platform: Node.js stdio MCP against the deployed API image in an isolated Docker network
driver: Node built-in assertions, child processes and HTTP; no browser or desktop input
sessions: One primary MCP process; additional account processes only for permission/revocation scenarios
production: Read-only connection inventory and health check; no production business-data writes
test_data: Fresh isolated PostgreSQL database and tmpfs artifact storage; all accounts, applications, artifacts and configuration are test-owned
external_services: Jenkins HTTP service is explicitly simulated inside the isolated network; no real Jenkins jobs triggered
upload_confirmation: The test harness simulates the host confirmation for test-owned fixture files only; no human approval or production publication is claimed
credentials: Synthetic isolated accounts; SSH password entered through getpass, never persisted; tokens remain in driver memory
assertions: Tool success must be followed by public API/tool-visible effects, download bytes or authentication/authorization effects
cleanup: Close MCP processes; delete only the temporary Git fixture and the exact named e2e Docker containers/network; preserve sanitized result artifacts
artifacts: tests/mcp-live/feature-matrix.json plus sanitized execution results in output/mcp-live-20261020
